paragraphs.text: The Bade Mountains is a mountainous region in North Aerona on Dominaria , north-east of the Whispering Woods and south of the Smoke Mountains .

During the Dark Age , there was a village in a grove on the farthest mountain from the sea. In the village lived the Family, a group of women and their children, who were fathered by the Rag Man of the Bade Mountains. The Family included seventeen adult women and their children.
